title: signal
description: Full outer join of Family A + Family B on the grain — a cell exists if EITHER heat does; STEALTH is the analytical-only/empirical-absent case. Schema defined in v0.0.1 but not populated (v0.0.2 product layer). See data-dictionary.md §5 and data-model.md §5.3.
x-grain: ticker × window_start × resolution — the Attention×Action product

ticker.description: Whitelist-validated symbol; must exist in instrument.

window_start.description: Inclusive lower bound of the half-open window [window_start, +len(resolution)).

resolution.description: Window length. 1h is the v0.0.1 primary.

h_e.x-null: no empirical row (a STEALTH cell — market moving, WSB silent); treated as WSB-quiet for the quadrant
h_e.description: WSB Heat, carried onto the signal cell from empirical_feature.

h_m.description: Market Heat, carried onto the signal cell from analytical_feature.

coverage_scope.description: Why this ticker has a market row: wsb_hot (top-N by H_e) ∪ screener_mover (market-wide, no WSB heat → STEALTH candidate, no empirical row). Makes analytical_feature INDEPENDENT of empirical_feature, not a subset.

divergence.x-null: either heat missing — can't subtract an unknown
divergence.description: h_e − h_m when both present, else null. Large +ve = hype ahead of market; large −ve = market ahead of WSB.

quadrant.description: Pure function of (h_e, h_m) vs each one's rolling median: confirmed (both hot), hype (WSB hot, market quiet), stealth (market hot, WSB quiet), quiet (both low). A missing heat is treated as 'quiet' on that axis, so a STEALTH cell (null h_e) still gets a badge.

rank.description: Board position on the combined product (1 = top).

rank_delta.description: Rank change vs the previous window: prior_rank − cur_rank. +ve = climbing.

lead_lag_hrs.description: Per-ticker argmax of the cross-correlation between H_e(t) and H_m(t) over a trailing window. +ve = WSB attention leads market by ~x h. Reports association, not prediction.

computed_at.description: Observation time of the signal derivation.
